name: Magnolia Point
summary: Magnolia Point is a community shopping center located on FM 1488 in Magnolia, Texas, part of Curbline Properties' national portfolio. The center serves the rapidly growing northwest Houston suburban market with convenient daily retail and service offerings.
demographics: Magnolia Point serves the rapidly growing northwest Houston suburban market of Magnolia, Texas, attracting middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes typically ranging from $75,000 to $150,000. The primary trade area consists of young families and established professionals aged 30-55 who have relocated to this master-planned community area for its highly-rated schools and quality of life. Shoppers in this market demonstrate strong preferences for convenience-oriented retail, family dining options, and service-based tenants that support their suburban lifestyle.
description: Magnolia Point is a neighborhood shopping center strategically located at 13371 Farm to Market Road 1488 in Magnolia, Texas, serving the thriving northwest Houston metropolitan area. This property is part of Curbline Properties' extensive portfolio of community-focused retail centers across the United States, which includes over 100 shopping centers spanning multiple states from California to Florida. The center operates daily from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM, providing convenient access to essential retail and services for the rapidly expanding Magnolia community. Positioned along the heavily-trafficked FM 1488 corridor, Magnolia Point benefits from the significant residential growth occurring in Montgomery County, one of the fastest-growing counties in Texas. The shopping center exemplifies Curbline Properties' strategy of acquiring and managing well-located retail properties in high-growth suburban markets that serve the everyday needs of their surrounding communities.
